title: Refresh the Moodle token
description: Signs in to Moodle through the Playwright server, captures the mobile-launch redirect without a model in the loop, stores MOODLE_TOKEN for the moodle server and restarts it. The capture script is set on the Mac (runbook G5); until then the capture step fails with a clear message.

steps.title: Sign in with SSO
steps.instructions: Sign in with SSO in the browser window, then run: toolportctl task resume <run-id>
